notice: Original planning cards. Cost and time are proposed pilot allowances, not observed benchmarks. Null case means no historical result is claimed.

tactics.mechanism: Turn an existing problem thread into a useful worked answer that demonstrates the product job.
tactics.artifact: One minimal example and explanation with affiliation disclosed if relevant
tactics.manual_test: Help on three relevant threads, each with a different concrete artifact; founder posts only where appropriate.
tactics.signal: Unique people who use the example and request the next step / people helped
tactics.stop: Stop after three relevant contributions or seven days if nobody uses the artifact.
tactics.failure: An irrelevant product link makes the answer promotional.

tactics.mechanism: A consenting small group brings actual workflows; the founder diagnoses and teaches one repeatable fix.
requires: Named audience with the same job
tactics.artifact: A short agenda, synthetic demo, and take-home checklist
tactics.manual_test: Offer one host a five-person teardown; record which fixes participants actually use.
tactics.signal: Participants who complete the fix or request a qualified trial / attendees
tactics.stop: Cancel if no relevant participants commit by the agreed date; do not keep promoting empty sessions.
tactics.failure: Friendly attendance masks lack of a recurring problem.

tactics.mechanism: A reusable job artifact creates value now and exposes the next workflow.
requires: A useful artifact independent of signup
tactics.artifact: One complete template, example inputs, and optional next step
tactics.manual_test: Give five target users a working template in the chosen room; ask what they used.
tactics.signal: Users reusing the template and trying the next job / qualified recipients
tactics.stop: Revise or stop if five target users cannot name a useful output in seven days.
tactics.failure: Template collectors never become product users.

tactics.mechanism: A shared small task produces visible progress and peer help.
tactics.artifact: Challenge brief, sample submission, bounded reward if any
tactics.manual_test: Run one host-approved challenge with five consenting participants; measure completed work.
tactics.signal: Participants completing the useful task and repeating it / starters
tactics.stop: Stop if fewer than the agreed minimum start or if host asks; no manufactured participation.
tactics.failure: Prize interest overwhelms the actual job.

tactics.mechanism: A specific observable workflow problem earns a useful diagnosis before a sales ask.
requires: A result the founder can defend
tactics.artifact: One short audit with evidence and one fix
tactics.manual_test: Prepare five individually researched audits; founder sends only relevant ones.
tactics.signal: Qualified replies discussing the diagnosed job / delivered relevant audits
tactics.stop: Stop after five or seven days with no job-specific reply and inspect targeting.
tactics.failure: Pretend personalization or unsupported security/performance claims.

tactics.mechanism: Remove the cost of trying an alternative at an explicitly observed switching moment.
tactics.artifact: Migration map, sample conversion, limitations, and rollback outline
tactics.manual_test: Offer three relevant prospects a synthetic/redacted trial migration before any commitment.
tactics.signal: Prospects completing a trial migration and first value / eligible offers
tactics.stop: Stop if the migration cannot preserve the promised fields or nobody accepts the small test.
tactics.failure: Celebrating competitor failure or claiming compatibility without a test.

tactics.mechanism: Deliver a bounded useful result instead of demanding a meeting before value.
requires: A prospect with this exact task
tactics.artifact: A sample output and an offer to reproduce it on suitable inputs
tactics.manual_test: Show three named prospects a synthetic example and ask if that output would help.
tactics.signal: Prospects supplying a relevant input or accepting a pilot / delivered offers
tactics.stop: Stop if none want the result; do not rephrase into five call requests.
tactics.failure: Free custom work has no path to recurring paid value.

tactics.mechanism: A satisfied user can introduce a peer whose same problem is known.
requires: No pressure to reveal private contacts
tactics.artifact: Forwardable explanation of one job and an optional introduction ask
tactics.manual_test: Ask three satisfied users whether one peer would benefit; founder does not import their contacts.
tactics.signal: Accepted relevant introductions reaching a first conversation / users asked
tactics.stop: Stop on refusal; revisit the job if no one can name a relevant peer.
tactics.failure: Mistaking social politeness for recommendation strength.

tactics.mechanism: A specific welcomed reply builds affinity where target users already converse.
tactics.artifact: One original reply and a no-reply alternative
tactics.manual_test: Review five real opportunities, select only welcomed relevant ones, founder posts individually.
tactics.signal: Relevant conversations and source-mentioned inbound / replies posted
tactics.stop: Stop after the bounded pilot if only empty engagement appears, or immediately on clear negative feedback.
tactics.failure: Generic banter gets laughs from nonbuyers.

tactics.mechanism: Repurpose a platform feature into a small task naturally related to the product job.
tactics.artifact: One sample interaction, participation brief, and useful result
tactics.manual_test: Invite five existing willing audience members to test the interaction before public launch.
tactics.signal: People completing a useful interaction and taking the relevant next action / participants
tactics.stop: Stop if the feature fails, moderation exceeds the cap, or interaction has no product bridge.
tactics.failure: Copying a large branded stunt without its resources.

tactics.mechanism: A meaningful private achievement becomes an optional shareable artifact that serves the recipient.
tactics.artifact: An anonymized example achievement card and recipient landing path
tactics.manual_test: Show five retained users manual cards; observe whether they choose to share and recipients try the workflow.
tactics.signal: Recipient first-value completions / unique recipients, plus voluntary shares / eligible users
tactics.stop: Stop if users find the result private, trivial, or unworthy of sharing.
tactics.failure: A vanity badge advertises the vendor rather than the user.

tactics.mechanism: A real second-person task creates a useful invitation after first value.
requires: A workflow that needs another person
tactics.artifact: Sender task, recipient preview, and invitation/decline flow
tactics.manual_test: Manually support five existing teams through the second-person task before building invites.
tactics.signal: Recipients reaching their first value / unique invited people
tactics.stop: Stop if collaboration is artificial or invitees cannot act without a long setup.
tactics.failure: Treating every invite as a newly acquired customer.

tactics.mechanism: An earned recommendation and relevant reward bring another user to a qualifying value event.
tactics.artifact: Program terms and one value-moment prompt
tactics.manual_test: Pilot manually with ten eligible users and settle only qualifying rewards.
tactics.signal: Referred retained/paying users / eligible referrers, with contribution after costs
tactics.stop: Pause when liability reaches the cap or the cohort fails the predeclared contribution floor.
tactics.failure: Rewards recruit self-referrals or users who never return.

tactics.mechanism: A free diagnostic answers a searched job and connects its result to the paid next step.
tactics.artifact: Manual result specimen, tool brief, and one search-intent page outline
tactics.manual_test: Produce outputs for five target users before commissioning a tool; research actual query competition.
tactics.signal: Qualified product activations / unique tool users
tactics.stop: Stop the build if users want the result but none need the next paid job.
tactics.failure: Broad free traffic overwhelms costs without buyer relevance.

tactics.mechanism: Answer a specific comparison and migration question with an honest tested example.
tactics.artifact: One comparison with limitations, test method, and sample migration
tactics.manual_test: Use the draft with five relevant switchers before publishing; founder verifies factual claims.
tactics.signal: Qualified trials completing migration / relevant page visitors
tactics.stop: Stop expansion if the single page attracts the wrong intent or compatibility is unproven.
tactics.failure: Fabricated comparison tables and dozens of thin alternatives pages.

tactics.mechanism: A useful maintained resource earns citations and introduces the paid workflow.
requires: A named first placement within search distribution
tactics.artifact: Small complete dataset/template library and maintenance policy
tactics.manual_test: Share the smallest useful resource with five target users and one relevant resource curator.
tactics.signal: Relevant users trying the paid next job / resource users
tactics.stop: Stop if the audience differs from buyers or maintenance exceeds the cap.
tactics.failure: The side resource becomes a second business accidentally.

tactics.mechanism: An expert demonstrates a real job to an overlapping trusted audience.
tactics.artifact: Joint demonstration brief and specific pitch
tactics.manual_test: Propose one small episode or teardown with a clear maximum cost and tracked next action.
tactics.signal: Qualified first-value users and contribution / total collaboration cost
tactics.stop: Stop if no audience evidence or agreed deliverable is available; do not prepay an unbounded campaign.
tactics.failure: Large follower count hides poor buying-role fit.

tactics.mechanism: Two adjacent products make a combined workflow easier and distribute it to actual users.
tactics.artifact: One joint template and owner per side
tactics.manual_test: Test the recipe with three shared target users before requesting a listing or announcement.
tactics.signal: Shared-workflow completions / referred qualified users
tactics.stop: Stop if either side contributes only a logo or the workflow requires unsupported features.
tactics.failure: A launch announcement substitutes for a functioning recipe.

tactics.mechanism: A service provider improves a client delivery task using the product.
requires: Permission and terms for shared examples
tactics.artifact: Client-safe demo, agency value proposition, and referral terms if needed
tactics.manual_test: Offer one named specialist a small nonexclusive trial on synthetic inputs.
tactics.signal: Qualified client pilots completing the task / agency introductions
tactics.stop: Stop if the agency cannot identify the task or requires unsupportable custom work.
tactics.failure: Confusing a friendly partnership discussion with distribution.

tactics.mechanism: An honest access constraint turns interest into qualified invitation cohorts.
requires: Access dates and reward budget if used
tactics.artifact: Waitlist promise, qualification question, confirmation, and first-wave plan
tactics.manual_test: Recruit ten qualified people through the chosen launch surface and invite only the number support can onboard.
tactics.signal: Invited people reaching first value / invitations delivered; repeat value later
tactics.stop: Stop acquisition if promises cannot be honored or invited people fail to reach value.
tactics.failure: List size gets called PMF.

tactics.mechanism: A working artifact gives a relevant launch audience an immediate experience and a reason to discuss.
tactics.artifact: One primary post, sample demo, and factual objection replies
tactics.manual_test: Run a private rehearsal with three target users before the founder submits to the chosen channel.
tactics.signal: Qualified first-value users / launch visitors
tactics.stop: Delay if the demo fails or only a signup page exists for a try-before-discussion channel.
tactics.failure: Leaderboard rank replaces customer evidence.

tactics.mechanism: A useful transparent method invites informed discussion from people who do the same work.
tactics.artifact: One reproducible method, redacted inputs, limitations, and result
tactics.manual_test: Share a small real method with three relevant peers for accuracy before founder publishes.
tactics.signal: Job-specific conversations and relevant artifact reuse / observed interactions
tactics.stop: Stop if publication exposes private data or only spectacle matters.
tactics.failure: Transparency theater without a decision-useful artifact.
